Purpose: understand the shape of `npx_data1` before writing any app code.
Data are Olink's synthetic example datasets shipped with OlinkAnalyze.

```{r setup}
library(OlinkAnalyze)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
# Source shared helpers. here::here() would be nicer; this keeps deps minimal.
for (f in list.files("../R", pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE)) source(f)
packageVersion("OlinkAnalyze")
```

## Shape

Long format: one row per (sample, assay). Wide format (samples × proteins)
is derived only when needed, e.g. for PCA.

```{r shape}
npx <- load_npx_demo("npx_data1")
dim(npx)
glimpse(npx)
str(npx_summary(npx))
```

## Clinical variables

```{r metadata}
npx |>
  filter(!is_control_sample(npx)) |>
  distinct(SampleID, Subject, Treatment, Site, Time) |>
  count(Treatment, Time)
```
